xp = 0

coins = [new_sprite({"image": "coin"}) for _ in range(8)]

def screen_title():  # shown while mode is "title"
    clear_screen("dark blue")
    write_text("COIN QUEST", 24, 18, "yellow")  # on HUD
    show_button("play", 44, 40)
    show_button("options", 40, 58)

def screen_options():  # shown while mode is "options"
    clear_screen("dark gray")
    write_text("OPTIONS", 36, 14, "white")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"difficulty {difficulty}", 8, 34, "white")  # on HUD
    show_button("easy", 6, 48)
    show_button("normal", 40, 48)
    show_button("hard", 80, 48)
    write_text(f"music {music}", 8, 74, "white")  # on HUD
    show_button("toggle music", 20, 88)
    show_button("back", 48, 108)

def screen_credits():  # shown while mode is "credits"
    clear_screen("dark purple")
    write_text("CREDITS", 36, 20, "white")  # on HUD
    write_text("made with", 30, 50, "white")  # on HUD
    write_text("fantasy computer", 14, 62, "yellow")  # on HUD
    show_button("back", 48, 100)

def screen_play():  # shown while mode is "play"
    clear_screen("dark green")
    for tree in trees:
        draw_sprite(tree["x"], tree["y"])
    for coin in coins:
        draw_sprite(coin["x"], coin["y"])
    for medkit in medkits:
        draw_sprite(medkit["x"], medkit["y"])
    for enemy in enemies:
        draw_sprite(enemy["x"], enemy["y"])
    for bullet in bullets:
        draw_sprite(bullet["x"], bullet["y"])
    if player["invuln"] == 0 or player["invuln"] % 6 > 2:
        draw_sprite(player["x"], player["y"])
    write_text("HP", 2, 3, "white")  # on HUD
    draw_meter(player["hp"], player["max_hp"], 16, 2, 44, 7, "red")
    write_text(f"coins {score}", 2, 14, "yellow")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"xp {xp}", 64, 14, "green")  # on HUD

def screen_win():  # shown while mode is "win"
    clear_screen("dark green")
    write_text("YOU WIN!", 36, 30, "yellow")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"score {score}", 38, 50, "white")  # on HUD

def screen_lose():  # shown while mode is "lose"

    write_text("GAME OVER", 34, 30, "red")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"score {score}", 38, 50, "white")  # on HUD
    show_button("retry", 46, 80)
    show_button("menu", 46, 100)

def update():

        return
    if player["invuln"] > 0:
        player["invuln"] -= 1
    move_with_arrows("player")

# when the player picks up coin

    if not coins:
        mode = "win"

# when the player picks up medkit
if player_picks_up("medkit"):
    heal("player", 2)

# when key "space" is pressed
if key_pressed("space"):

        shoot()

# when key "enter" is pressed
if key_pressed("enter"):
    if mode == "play":
        shoot()

def shoot():
    bullet = new_sprite("zero", {"image": "arrow", "x": player["x"], "y": player["y"], "dx": player["dx"], "dy": player["dy"], "facing": player["facing"], "speed": 3})
    bullets.append(bullet)

# when the player hits enemy
if player_hits("enemy"):
    if player["invuln"] > 0:
        return
    # knock (target=player, source=enemy)
    damage("player", 2)
    player["invuln"] = 45
    if player["hp"] < 1:
        mode = "lose"

# when the player defeats enemy
if player_defeats("enemy"):
    xp += 10

# when the "play" button is tapped
if button_tapped("play"):
    restart(game)
    go_to_screen("play")

# when the "options" button is tapped
if button_tapped("options"):
    go_to_screen("options")

# when the "credits" button is tapped
if button_tapped("credits"):
    go_to_screen("credits")

# when the "back" button is tapped
if button_tapped("back"):
    go_back()

# when the "menu" button is tapped
if button_tapped("menu"):
    go_to_screen("title")

# when the "retry" button is tapped

    go_to_screen("play")

# when the "play again" button is tapped

    go_to_screen("play")

# when the "easy" button is tapped

    player["speed"] = 0.8

# when the "normal" button is tapped

    player["speed"] = 0.6

# when the "hard" button is tapped

    enemies = [new_sprite({"image": "slime"}) for _ in range(6)]

# when the "toggle music" button is tapped

    player["y"] = 96
    player["hp"] = player["max_hp"]
    player["invuln"] = 0
    coins = [new_sprite({"image": "coin"}) for _ in range(8)]
    medkits = [new_sprite({"image": "medkit"}) for _ in range(3)]
run_game(update)

# Illustrative Python translation of your fc program.
# Read-only — shows the shape. draw_*/play_sound/etc. are
# fantasy-console calls (fc has a built-in game engine).

mode = "play"
score = 0
gravity = 0.18
player = {"x": 28, "y": 50, "image": "ship", "dy": 0}
pipes = []
define_sound("flap")
define_sound("point")
define_sound("smack")

# when key "space" is pressed
if key_pressed("space"):
    if mode == "play":
        jump("player", 2.5)
    play_sound("flap")

# when the mouse is clicked
if mouse_clicked():
    if mode == "play":
        jump("player", 2.5)
    play_sound("flap")

def update():
    if mode != "play":
        return

    # every 180 frames
    if frame % 180 == 0:
        g = random.randint(0, 44)
        pipe = sprite
        pipe["x"] = 128
        pipe["gy"] = g + 12
        pipe["passed"] = False
        pipes.append(pipe)
    for pipe in pipes:
        pipe["x"] = pipe["x"] - 0.65
        if pipe["x"] + 12 < player["x"] and pipe["passed"] == False:
            pipe["passed"] = True
            score += 1
            play_sound("point")
        if player["x"] + 6 > pipe["x"] and player["x"] < pipe["x"] + 12:
            if player["y"] < pipe["gy"]:
                mode = "lose"
                play_sound("smack")
            if player["y"] + 8 > pipe["gy"] + 40:
                mode = "lose"
                play_sound("smack")
    if player["y"] > 116:
        mode = "lose"
        play_sound("smack")
    if len(pipes) > 0:
        oldest = pipes[0]
        if oldest["x"] < -14:
            pipes.remove(oldest)

def draw():
    clear_screen("dark blue")
    for pipe in pipes:
        draw_rect(pipe["x"], 0, 12, pipe["gy"], "green")
        draw_rect(pipe["x"], pipe["gy"] + 40, 12, 90, "green")
    draw_sprite(player["x"], player["y"])
    write_text(f"score {score}", 2, 2, "white")  # on HUD

def screen_lose():  # shown while mode is "lose"
    write_text("GAME OVER", 32, 54, "red")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"score {score}", 38, 70, "white")  # on HUD
run_game(update, draw)

frogger.fc.python:
# Illustrative Python translation of your fc program.
# Read-only — shows the shape. draw_*/play_sound/etc. are
# fantasy-console calls (fc has a built-in game engine).

mode = "play"
score = 0
lives = 3
player = {"x": 60, "y": 112, "image": "slime"}
home = {"x": 60, "y": 12, "image": "star"}
cars = []
lanes = [{"y": 96, "dir": 1, "speed": 0.6}, {"y": 80, "dir": 0 - 1, "speed": 0.9}, {"y": 64, "dir": 1, "speed": 1.2}, {"y": 48, "dir": 0 - 1, "speed": 0.7}]
for lane in lanes:
    for i in range(0, 2 + 1):
        car = sprite
        car["x"] = i * 44 + 6
        car["y"] = lane["y"]
        car["dir"] = lane["dir"]
        car["speed"] = lane["speed"]
        car["image"] = "ship"
        cars.append(car)
set_tag("cars", "hostile")  # cars are hostile
define_sound("hop")
define_sound("splat")
define_sound("home")

# when key "up" is pressed
if key_pressed("up"):
    if mode == "play":
        player["y"] -= 16
        play_sound("hop")

# when key "down" is pressed
if key_pressed("down"):
    if mode == "play" and player["y"] < 112:
        player["y"] += 16
        play_sound("hop")

# when key "left" is pressed
if key_pressed("left"):
    if mode == "play" and player["x"] > 8:
        player["x"] -= 16
        play_sound("hop")

# when key "right" is pressed
if key_pressed("right"):
    if mode == "play" and player["x"] < 112:
        player["x"] += 16
        play_sound("hop")

def update():
    if mode != "play":
        return
    for car in cars:
        car["x"] = car["x"] + car["dir"] * car["speed"]
        if car["x"] > 132:
            car["x"] = 0 - 8
        if car["x"] < 0 - 8:
            car["x"] = 132
    if player["y"] <= 16:
        score += 1
        play_sound("home")
        for car in cars:
            car["speed"] = car["speed"] + 0.12
        player["x"] = 60
        player["y"] = 112

# when the player hits car
if player_hits("car"):
    lives -= 1
    play_sound("splat")
    player["x"] = 60
    player["y"] = 112
    if lives == 0:
        mode = "lose"

def draw():
    clear_screen("black")
    draw_rect(0, 40, 128, 64, "dark gray")
    draw_rect(0, 104, 128, 24, "dark green")
    draw_rect(0, 8, 128, 24, "dark green")
    draw_sprite(home["x"], home["y"])
    for car in cars:
        draw_sprite(car["x"], car["y"])
    draw_sprite(player["x"], player["y"])

    if key_pressed("up"):

    if key_pressed("w"):

    if key_pressed("down"):

    if key_pressed("s"):
        p1 += 2
    if p1 < 0:
        p1 = 0
    if p1 > 104:
        p1 = 104
    if ball["y"] > p2 + 14:
        p2 += 1
    if ball["y"] < p2 + 10:
        p2 -= 1
    if p2 < 0:
        p2 = 0
    if p2 > 104:
        p2 = 104
    ball["x"] = ball["x"] + ball["dx"]
    ball["y"] = ball["y"] + ball["dy"]
    if ball["y"] < 2:
        ball["dy"] = 0 - ball["dy"]
        play_sound("bounce")
    if ball["y"] > 123:
        ball["dy"] = 0 - ball["dy"]
        play_sound("bounce")
    if ball["x"] < 6 and ball["y"] > p1 and ball["y"] < p1 + 24:

snake.fc.python:
# Illustrative Python translation of your fc program.
# Read-only — shows the shape. draw_*/play_sound/etc. are
# fantasy-console calls (fc has a built-in game engine).

mode = "play"
score = 0
tick = 0
dx = 8
dy = 0
hx = 64
hy = 64
body = []
start = {"x": 64, "y": 64}
body.append(start)
food = {"x": 32, "y": 32}
define_sound("eat")
define_sound("die")

def update():
    if mode != "play":
        return
    if key_pressed("left") and dx == 0:
        dx = 0 - 8
        dy = 0
    if key_pressed("right") and dx == 0:
        dx = 8
        dy = 0
    if key_pressed("up") and dy == 0:
        dx = 0
        dy = 0 - 8
    if key_pressed("down") and dy == 0:
        dx = 0
        dy = 8
    tick = tick + 1
    if tick % 14 != 0:
        return
    nx = hx + dx
    ny = hy + dy
    if nx < 0 or nx > 120 or ny < 0 or ny > 120:
        mode = "lose"
        play_sound("die")
        return
    for seg in body:
        if seg["x"] == nx and seg["y"] == ny:
            mode = "lose"
    if mode == "lose":
        play_sound("die")
        return
    head = {"x": nx, "y": ny}
    body.append(head)
    hx = nx
    hy = ny
    ate = False
    if nx == food["x"] and ny == food["y"]:
        score += 1
        play_sound("eat")
        fx = random.randint(0, 15)
        fy = random.randint(0, 15)
        food["x"] = fx * 8
        food["y"] = fy * 8
        ate = True
    if not ate:
        tail = body[0]
        body.remove(tail)

def draw():
    clear_screen("black")
    for seg in body:
        draw_rect(seg["x"], seg["y"], 7, 7, "green")
    draw_rect(food["x"], food["y"], 7, 7, "red")
    write_text(f"score {score}", 2, 2, "white")  # on HUD

def screen_lose():  # shown while mode is "lose"
    write_text("GAME OVER", 32, 56, "red")  # on HUD
    write_text(f"score {score}", 38, 72, "white")  # on HUD
run_game(update, draw)
